summary: Iteration 90 checked the 6 leftover fixes from iteration_89 plus a smoke test at 390x844. All 7 items pass. Backend: 20/20 new tests in tests/test_iter90_fixes.py pass, and the 75 tests in the 3 existing suites (phase4 CRM, phase6c reps, notification_center) still pass. (1) CRM New filter: the API returns 4 leads and every row has status 'new'. The UI 'New' chip shows the same 4 rows, each with the New badge. (2) Legacy Neighbours kinds are absent from /notifications/center for all 13 categories. unread (527 for demo) equals /unread-count equals the sum of unread_by_category. /notifications and Feeds → Activity show none of the banned strings (resident request / wants to connect / Lekki Gardens Phase 2). Mark-all-read was checked in the UI on adaeze (83 → 0, 'You're all caught up'), then her 83 unread rows were restored in the DB. Dismiss → restore and read/unread round trips work. (3) /agent/representations/mine: 200 rows, all with a non-null property. The header reads '168 need your action', which matches the 168 PENDING/DOCS_REQUESTED rows the API returned. (4) Saved search Run now on a fresh device (localStorage cleared, token only): Find Home opens with Rent selected and the filter badge at 1. intent-sheet never appears (checked at 0.5, 1.5, 3.5 and 5 s), Rent is still selected after 5 s, and there are 0 console errors. (5) FIXA directory call/WhatsApp buttons and the Feeds Nearby 'Pros near you' rail mini buttons all measure 44x44. Nothing is clipped at 390 px (page scrollWidth 390; mini cards 220x152 with no overflowing children). (6) The admin settings flag reads 'Google Places', and 'AI valuation narrative' is unchanged. (7) Smoke: UI login, Find Home (3 pins), Feeds, Market, My Home, My Amass and Inbox all load with 0 console errors or page errors. One minor UX finding: right after Run now, Find Home says 'None in view · Explore wider' even though the run found 7 matches. Tapping Explore wider then shows '7 homes in view'. No deprecated Expo packages and no react-native SafeAreaView imports were found.

Reads only the newest 200 reps (to_list(200)) and then drops orphans. Demo returns exactly 200, so the header's pending count ('168 need your action') only covers those 200 and older reps cannot be reached (no pagination).
